parameters.name: CallbackFnFTaskToken
parameters.description: The token of a task to be called back after the flow execution is complete.

parameters.name: ExecutionName
parameters.description:
The name of the execution. The name must be unique within the same flow. The name must meet the following requirements:

- It must start with a letter (a-z or A-Z) or an underscore (\_).

- It can contain letters (a-z or A-Z), digits (0-9), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).

- It is case-sensitive.

- It must be 1 to 128 characters in length.

parameters.name: FlowName
parameters.description: The name of the flow to execute.

parameters.name: Input
parameters.description: The input for the execution. The input must be in the JSON object format.

parameters.name: Qualifier
parameters.description: The version or alias of the flow.
